questions.question: Which specimen or diagnostic finding belongs in a reference record for Cyclospora cayetanensis?
options: Microfilariae in a peripheral blood film.
Malaria rings inside erythrocytes in a thin blood film.
Asymmetrical pinworm eggs on a perianal adhesive-tape specimen.
questions.explanation: Unsporulated oocysts in stool. Concentration, modified acid-fast microscopy and fluorescence support detection; molecular assays can confirm.
